What is Burger Shift: Team Rush?

This first-person fast food restaurant simulator supports solo play and co-op with up to eight players. You grill burgers, operate fryers, and pour sodas to fill orders while dealing with unusual customers and unexpected events.

For you if...

  • +you like coordinating roles and deciding which orders take priority

Not for you if...

  • −you prefer managing a restaurant without doing the cooking yourself

What players say

85% of 53 reviews are positive · 87% of 16 in the last 30 days

Players praise cooking with friends and the time-management gameplay. The most common complaints concern hired staff: players say workers contribute too little and cooks prepare food customers have not ordered, wasting money.

Does Burger Shift: Team Rush have co-op or multiplayer?

Yes: co-op online and LAN. It also has a single-player mode.

Does Burger Shift: Team Rush run on Steam Deck?

Playable Playable: it runs on Steam Deck with some adjustments.

  • Default controller config not fully functional
  • Sometimes shows mouse, keyboard or non-Deck controller icons
  • Some text entry requires manually opening the on-screen keyboard
  • All functionality is accessible with the default controller configuration
  • In-game text is legible on Steam Deck
  • Default graphics settings perform well on Steam Deck

Does Burger Shift: Team Rush use AI-generated content?

Yes. The developers disclose AI-generated content on the game's Steam page:

The game itself does not include any AI-generated content. AI-generated tools were used solely to assist in creating some of the promotional material displayed on this Steam page.

The statement mentions: Store page & marketing

Self-reported by the developer under Steam rules: it covers AI content that ships in the game, not tools used to make it. Steam page checked on Oct 28, 2026. How to filter AI games on Steam
